label: D2 after choosing a2 and landing in S1 (rare a2 transition), early/mid episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only after the agent chose a2 (in_action == 2 at D2). The strong activations (top two quartiles, ~92% of activation mass) are the rare a2 transition, i.e. reached state S1 after a2; they are larger when the previous trial was rewarded (~0.85-1.0 of max) than unrewarded (~0.5-0.65). It also fires weakly (<~0.2 of max) on common a2 -> S2 D2 steps, which make up most of the lowest-quartile activations and are the main source of missed binary recall. Never fires at D1 or GO, nor after a1. Activity declines through the episode and is absent after ~trial 80, so ep_trial < 70 is added (precision 0.61 -> 0.86 on dev). Everything used is observed at D2 (action and the reached state), so no future variables. Simpler predicate (phase==D2)&(action==2)&(common==0) gets dev F1 0.59, mass recall 0.92.
